Editorial standard

Evidence before entertainment.

Published field notes cite primary official sources, show a last-verified date, separate fact from inference and unknowns, protect private people and properties, and point to a useful next action.

PermitPulse field notes are informational, not legal or professional advice. Rules, systems, records, and implementation status can change; recheck the current official source before relying on a claim.
